title: Argentine Constitution of 1826
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Argentine Constitution of 1826", at revision 1271040803, opens: "The Argentine Constitution of 1826 was a short-lived Constitution of Argentina drafted during the Argentine Civil Wars. Bernardino Rivadavia was appointed President of Argentina under this constitution. It was rejected by most Argentine provinces, and then abolished." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5784579, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "short-lived constitution of Argentina". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
